[[File:Snothead chathead.png|left|55px]]
'''Snothead''' is an undead goblin priest fought in the [[Land of the Goblins]] quest. He is the first priest fought in the [[Goblin Temple]]'s crypt in an attempt to find the location of [[Yu'biusk]]. After the quest, [[Hopespear]] asks the player to free the souls of the goblin priests in [[Hopespear's Will]] miniquest, where he is fought again and put to rest on Yu'biusk.
